description.value:
Duration constant

Everyone who can hear you has become, without being asked, somebody who works for you.

Your called command and other Cadre abilities may target any willing creature who can hear and understand you, not only allies — bystanders, hirelings, prisoners, and people who happened to be in the building. A creature commanded this way who is not your ally may attempt a Will save against your Class DC to refuse, and most of them do not bother.

cinderfall.incomplete: The called command may target any willing creature, not just allies; a non-ally may Will-save vs. Class DC to refuse. Same "nothing to extend" gap, plus a save determining whether a non-ally complies has no rule-element resolution path either.
